t: Четыре БПЛА сбили на подлете к Москве — Собянин

te: Four UAVs shot down on approach to Moscow – Sobyanin
de: Four Ukrainian drones shot down air defense units on the approach to Moscow. On November 27, the mayor of the city Sergey Sobyanin said. “At the site of the fall of the wreckage, emergency services specialists are working,” he said…

t: Дептранс Москвы предупредил об изменении тарифов на проезд в транспорте

te: Deptrans of Moscow warned about the change in tariffs for travel in transport
de: Tariffs for travel in urban transport in Moscow will change from January 2, 2027. This was reported on November 27 in the press service of the Department of transport of the city. It is noted that the change in tariffs is necessary to compensate for price increases…

t: Путин отметил рост доходов жителей Архангельской области
d: Президент России Владимир Путин обратил внимание на рост среднедушевых доходов жителей Архангельской области на встрече с губернатором Александром Цыбульским. Встреча прошла 27 ноября в Северодвинске. «Среднедушевые доходы тоже растут»…
te: Putin noted the growth of incomes of residents of the Arkhangelsk region
de: Russian President Vladimir Putin drew attention to the growth of per capita incomes of residents of the Arkhangelsk region at a meeting with Governor Alexander Tsybulsky. The meeting was held on November 27 in Severodvinsk. “Average per capita incomes are also rising.”…

te: Criminals shot down an armored car with jewelry in Peru
de: In the Peruvian district of La Perla, criminals opened fire on an armored car, which, according to police, could be jewelry. This was reported on November 27 by the newspaper El Comercio. The attack happened the same morning…
